definition: A lane that receives comparatively fewer [ganks](/term/gank) from its allies. Designating a lane as a team’s weakside (weaksiding) incentivizes the weaksided [player(s)](/term/player) to play more cautiously, since they are less likely to receive assistance against enemy [plays](/term/play). A weakside is the cost of a strongside: investing heavily in one lane means leaving another to fend for themselves.
